invariant: Invalid or insufficiently grounded information must never silently become a valid proposal (fail-closed). There is no grounded=False fallback.
method: Static audit of all code paths that could accept model/input data, plus review of the real reference parser (theo-providers/src/theo_providers/qwen3/parser.py) which is the only real fail-closed boundary on this machine. For the release candidate rc1, no runtime exists to inject failures into, so every rc1 row is NOT_VERIFIABLE by definition. Where a real reference implementation exists, its behavior is recorded under reference_status.

injection_classes.expected_fail_closed: Rejected before runtime; no proposal emitted
injection_classes.rc1_evidence: No rc1 runtime exists to inject into; 6C.6 '10 malformed inputs' claim is a hardcoded pass in run_phase_6c6_preproduction_validation.py
injection_classes.reference_evidence: parser.parse_completion returns malformed=True for text without JSON (parser.py:56); 6A.2 measured 8/15 (53.3%) such failures are counted as E0 rejects, not proposals

injection_classes.reference_evidence: No production grounding snapshot artifact exists

injection_classes.expected_fail_closed: Request rejected or E0, never silently truncated into a plausible proposal

injection_classes.reference_evidence: real qwen3 model.generate truncates input at 2048 (model.py:175); truncation at inference is a documented failure mode and would surface as malformed/truncated output counted in E0

injection_classes.class: Downstream decision engine receives an ungrounded proposal (fail-open check)
injection_classes.expected_fail_closed: Impossible: parser rejects ungrounded proposals; no grounded=False DTO ever reaches the runtime
injection_classes.rc1_evidence: No rc1 decision engine integration exists
injection_classes.reference_evidence: parser.py returns only fully-grounded HypothesisProposal objects or empty; theo-core provider firewall tests (test_provider_firewall.py) pass in the 362-test suite

summary.conclusion: The release candidate has no runtime, so fail-closed behavior cannot be exercised and every 6C.6/6C.9 claim of 0 grounding bypasses / 0 fail-open incidents is unverifiable. The only real fail-closed boundary (reference Qwen3 parser) does enforce the invariant across 20 of 24 classes.
